fixes.explanation: It really is in there, friend. The Lord GOD of Hosts says, “Consider and realize how evil and bitter it is for you to forsake the LORD your God and to have no fear of Me…” (Jeremiah 2:19). Evil and bitter are the two words He picks, and He asks them to stop and think it over, so the statement is true. I get it, though. I've read a recipe three times, sure it said something else, and the page just kept saying the same thing.
